description: Buyer minimum requirements for ISO 3166-2 subdivision values that must remain independently selectable later. Country keys prevent a false cross-country capability claim. all_values requires support for every protocol-valid ISO subdivision active in the seller's support snapshot when the declaration is issued; values requests an exact finite candidate set. Exact delivery values known now belong in get_products.targeting_overlay instead.

all_values.description: Require every protocol-valid ISO 3166-2 subdivision active in the seller's returned support snapshot for this country to remain selectable.

values.description: Exact finite set of ISO 3166-2 identifiers the buyer may select later.

countries.description: Required ISO subdivision support keyed by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country.

title: Geographic Region Requirement
